However, the core mechanism (defect pinning → annealing → reduced hysteresis and enhanced MCE) is a textbook concept, and the application to a new alloy composition without a stated reason why this system should behave differently or why the low-dimensionality matters is a straightforward transfer. The hypothesis does not resolve any conflict or gap between passages, nor does it link evidence through a mechanism
